categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Bohui Science & Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the audiovisual big data sector, offering products and services in three main areas: media security, smart education, and intelligent display control. The company provides comprehensive audiovisual data collection, analysis, and visualization technologies, serving broadcasting institutions, educational organizations, and government enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include audiovisual big data collection, intelligent analysis, visualization, and content security. It develops proprietary software and hardware products based on advanced AI, 5G, cloud computing, blockchain, and digital twin technologies. Production is primarily software-driven with outsourced hardware assembly, emphasizing embedded software programming, testing, and integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and provincial broadcasting authorities, IPTV and telecom operators, network audiovisual platforms, universities, and government defense units. The company serves the media, education, and government-enterprise sectors, providing solutions for broadcast monitoring, content security, smart classrooms, and command center audiovisual control.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily within China, covering all provinces and major cities. The company’s products and services are deployed nationwide, including in Beijing, Shandong, Qinghai, Jiangsu, Anhui, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bohui Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the audiovisual technology supply chain. It develops proprietary software and hardware solutions and integrates third-party hardware components, focusing on system integration, software development, and end-user deployment rather than upstream component manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in AI, 5G, big data analytics, cloud computing, and digital twin technologies to enhance product competitiveness. It actively develops AI-driven content recognition, smart education platforms, and intelligent display control systems. Strategic initiatives include expanding AI applications in media security, education, and command centers, and fostering collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of audiovisual hardware and software solutions, along with customized technical services including system integration, installation, training, and ongoing maintenance. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with end customers and through authorized agents or system integrators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bohui Technology is a leading domestic player in the audiovisual big data and media security industry, recognized for its strong technical capabilities and comprehensive product portfolio. It holds significant market share with extensive coverage of national broadcasting and IPTV operators, and maintains a competitive edge through continuous innovation and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 191.8 million, a 22.21% increase year-over-year, but recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 43.17 million, reflecting a decline in profitability. Total assets stood at about RMB 826.5 million with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, accounting for nearly 29% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bohui Technology emphasizes its deep technical expertise, proprietary AI-driven audiovisual big data solutions, and comprehensive service capabilities. Its products offer high reliability, accuracy, and security tailored to the stringent requirements of broadcasting and education sectors. The company differentiates itself through integrated AI content recognition, smart classroom ecosystems, and flexible, scalable intelligent display control platforms, supporting customers’ digital transformation and regulatory compliance.
